key: # PROPOSAL (2026-10-21): a starting list of ~20 symptom families for the Symptom facet (docs/13 §8).
# Edit freely: key is the stable id the index and URLs carry; display is what the facet shows;
# patterns are '|'-separated case-insensitive substrings matched on the normalised symptom key
# the FIRST family in sort_order whose pattern matches wins (only when no human/seed/inherited family).
# Families are never minted by rules: this file is the only way one comes into being.

description: Flooding, seawater or water where it should not be
Smoke, sparks, soot, abnormal exhaust
Oil, fuel, water, gas or air escaping
Will not start or starts with difficulty
patterns: fail to start|fails to start|failed to start|not start|won t start|no start|cannot start|unable to start|hard start|failure to start

description: Stopped, stalled, blacked out, shut down (not a protective trip)
An alarm, trip, slowdown or protective cut-out
Vibration, shaking, juddering
Knocking, rattling, grinding, squealing
Overheating or temperature above normal
patterns: high temp|overheat|too hot|temperature high|temp high|running hot

description: Pressure below normal or lost
patterns: low press|pressure low|pressure drop|loss of pressure|no pressure

description: Pressure above normal
Short circuit, earth fault, supply, breaker, wiring
Wrong or missing reading, sensor, detector, controller, software
Blocked, clogged, choked, restricted flow
Sludge, deposits, dirt, fouling, foreign matter
Corrosion, rust, wastage
Wear, cracks, fractures, scoring, breakage, deformation
Off-spec fuel or lubricant
patterns: fuel quality|lube oil quality|viscosity|cat fine|off spec|off-spec|tbn|flash point|bunker quality

description: Higher than normal use of fuel, oil or water
Cannot reach load or speed, hunting, erratic running, reduced output
patterns: load limit|loss of power|power loss|low rpm|rpm drop|unable to reach|not reaching|low output|hunting|fluctuat|fails|failure|not open|not closing|too slow|zero
